evidence.note: Describes native workspace outcomes, providers, optional companion, and current edition scope. Documentation is a discovery lead, with capabilities checked against code below.
Common Swift sources exclude Wallet-prefixed files; common packages include SwiftTerm and Markdown.
Locus and LocusX targets use different source templates; wallet sources are added to LocusX.
Menu handlers open the library, changes, terminal, saved sessions and inspector destinations.
Inspector switch constructs file, changes, terminal, browser, simulator, calendar, board, run and model-router panels.
Inspector destinations define their user labels and workspace roles.
Native app attaches to an enabled independent runtime or resolves and starts the Python server on a local endpoint; unavailable runtime/port stops launch.
BackendService sets up authenticated WebSocket transport with either chat or runtime path; the latter uses an event cursor.
Native HTTP requests send the app authentication header, validate the response and decode JSON.
Backend registers domain route modules including sessions, schedules, goals, runtime, providers and extensions.
create_app composes FastAPI, shared chat state, middleware and registered routes.
Python backend manifest declares its runtime dependencies; declaration alone does not establish use.
Opening a workspace entry resolves containment and displays file/library preview; adding an entry supplies context or an attachment.
Browser panel uses the current session browser, attaches captures to chat, and exposes browser callbacks.
Browser menu invokes find, capture, history, downloads, tab restore, and console/network display.
Provider mutation validates the backend provider mode and invokes the local, remote or managed-account branch.
Provider selection and model listing handlers are registered as API routes.
Native provider state separates local models and per-account catalogs/status. No live account data was read.
Plugin install handler calls the extension manager under mutation control and refreshes tools/MCP.
Registered extension routes expose plugin/skill operations and MCP catalog, resources, prompts, tests and connection management.
Goal editor records chosen execution mode, provider and team; start/continue gates require an eligible idle chat and available capability.
Goal creation binds to an existing chat/workspace and rejects unavailable or active sessions before storing the objective.
Composer workflow menu opens the goal editor, Task Capsules and team choices.
Registered Task Capsule operations include create, read, update and validation.
Task Capsule sheet shows draft/saved plans and refreshes its library.
Response outputs link to saved versions; library integration opens documents/outputs for a workspace and supports image-edit attachment when available.
Output revision attaches a saved version and extracts supported documents, while refusing busy state or an occupied draft.
Calendar access requests and checks EventKit permission before retrieving calendars.
Calendar creation validates access/title/dates, selects a writable calendar and saves through EventKit.
Board shows workspace-scoped cards, opens detail/create sheets and dispatches changes through its store.
Mobile access setting gates pairing; the pair button invokes the native pairing flow.
Native pairing handler invokes the companion gateway and captures success or error.
Native companion request dispatcher handles chat, activity, schedule and approval requests; this is not an end-to-end mobile transport trace.
Remote runtime view exposes deploy, control and retrieve operations through backend requests.
Registered remote runtime routes support validated connection, snapshot review, deploy, retrieve and apply.
Remote runtime settings surface is conditional on RuntimeInstallation.enabled.
Computer action events gate native control by settings or task-scoped application access, call the native broker and send a result.
Native broker checks capture privacy, execution state, Accessibility permission and live task scope before an action.
Composer buttons invoke dictation and voice-mode toggles; live recognition/provider behavior is outside this trace.
Simulator panel chooses device or attached workspace and starts/stops its preview through the simulator service.

capabilities.title: Work with project files and changes
capabilities.description: Browse files, attach context, review changes and open a terminal beside the conversation.
capabilities.selection_reason: These supporting workspace actions are visible entrypoints; the main AI-work example shows the broader request path.

capabilities.title: Browse and inspect websites
capabilities.description: Use session browser tabs, attach captures, and inspect console/network information. The full agent-driven browser round trip is not traced here.
capabilities.selection_reason: A useful independent follow-up for understanding how native browser actions reach the agent.

capabilities.title: Choose models and accounts
capabilities.description: Select local Ollama or a configured remote/managed account and inspect per-account model catalogs. Availability depends on setup.
capabilities.selection_reason: Routing is central to the product, but tracing every provider would repeat much of the main AI-work story.

capabilities.title: Connect tools, plugins and skills
capabilities.description: Manage plugins/skills and MCP server connections, resources and prompts through registered extension operations.
capabilities.selection_reason: Extends the agent toolbox; individual extension execution paths can be inspected on demand.

capabilities.title: Keep working toward a goal
capabilities.description: Create an objective bound to a chat, workspace, model and optional team; continuation is gated by chat and account state.
capabilities.selection_reason: Durable continuation is a separate deep dive from the three representative first-look flows.

capabilities.title: Save and revisit task plans
capabilities.description: Open saved Task Capsules and create, update or validate their recipes. Recovery and verification internals are outside this first trace.
capabilities.selection_reason: A useful focused follow-up for saved progress and validation, without duplicating team execution in the overview.

capabilities.title: Revisit and revise outputs
capabilities.description: Open saved documents and output versions, preview them, or attach a saved version to prepare a revision. Image editing is conditional on backend support.
capabilities.selection_reason: Shows the deliverable lifecycle; individual extraction/export/image-generation paths are not traced in the default three examples.

capabilities.title: View and create calendar events
capabilities.description: Use macOS calendars after EventKit access is granted; creation validates fields and a writable calendar.
capabilities.selection_reason: A distinct native integration kept available for a focused request.

capabilities.title: Plan work on a shared board
capabilities.description: Use workspace-scoped cards, open their details and create or organize work through the Board panel.
capabilities.selection_reason: A user-facing planning surface whose full persistence and agent-tool path can be explored separately.

capabilities.title: Continue from a phone
capabilities.description: Enable Mobile Access, pair a companion, and dispatch chat, activity, approval and schedule requests. Device transport is not traced end to end.
capabilities.selection_reason: Optional companion integration; its boundary stays visible without taking a default walkthrough slot.

capabilities.title: Run agents on another host
capabilities.description: When independent runtimes are enabled, use remote deployment controls and retrieve returned changes. No real host was contacted.
capabilities.selection_reason: Optional execution topology deserves its own later trace; endpoint presence does not establish a deployed remote host.

capabilities.title: Let agents use Mac apps
capabilities.description: Native computer actions require enabled task access and macOS Accessibility permission, then return a result to the conversation.
capabilities.selection_reason: Native permission and action handling is an additional boundary that can be focused on separately.

capabilities.title: Dictate or use voice mode
capabilities.description: Composer controls start dictation or voice mode; live audio/recognition behavior was not followed.
capabilities.selection_reason: Optional input mode; the core work flow is representative of what happens after a request is submitted.

capabilities.title: Preview an iOS simulator
capabilities.description: Open a device picker or attached simulator workspace and start/stop its preview. A working installed simulator was not tested.
capabilities.selection_reason: Specialized development tool, available for a dedicated trace.

sections.title: Which Locus this report describes
sections.text: This is a first-look source report of the native Locus workspace and its Python agent backend. The build separates ordinary Locus from the optional wallet-bearing LocusX edition. Wallet execution, mobile transport, deployed remote hosts, generated build products, and third-party internals are outside the traced scope. The capability inventory lists discovered entrypoints; a missing walkthrough does not mean a feature is absent.

coverage.explanation: Checked visible menu/panel handlers and registered backend operations for the listed outcomes; selected three distinct journeys for deeper tracing.
